data.name: Janni Tempest
data.description: When you hit an opponent with an unarmed strike while using Janni StyleUC, you can spend 2 stamina points to increase this feat's bonus by 2. You can also spend 2 stamina points to apply the feat's bonus on checks to a dragAPG or repositionAPG combat maneuver instead of a bull rush or trip.
